title: 第十九章神秘的宝物第二十章收服地狱犬
content_zh:
第十九章神秘的宝物
亡灵法师杰斯利，拥有七阶巅峰的实力，而且还拥有这一片区域里最强的势力！本来因为周围的地狱犬的骚扰，没能统一这片区域，就让杰斯利很是头疼了。不过即使这样杰斯利不会担心有什么威胁，毕竟自己的势力很强。可是就在前一段时间，这种情况完全改变了。
先是有一支神秘的势力，不断的攻击着自己的手下！而且极其狡猾每次自己要去清剿，他们就会突然消失！还有在自己临近的哈莱姆也开始趁火打劫！最可气的是连自己以前并不放在眼里的灵魔也来攻击自己。
本来这些小势力攻击，并不会对杰斯利造成多大的损失！可是就在杰斯利为这些骚扰感到心烦的时候，杰斯利背后的地狱犬竟然也来攻击自己。而且是全族群出动，让杰斯利感觉到仿佛是自己杀了它们孩子一样！让它们不要命的攻击自己！其实杰斯利不知道这些地狱犬，正是认为是他杀死了它们的孩子。如果杰斯利知道后，肯定冤枉的吐血！要是亡灵有血的话！
陈林现在像一个局外人一样，看着周围的这些势力不断的战斗着。而且不断利用自己超强的精神力探索周围势力的动向，让小黑和灵魔能在这场战斗中存活下来。现在的情况都在陈林的掌控当中，不过唯一让陈林疑惑的是，到现在为止地狱犬的那个头领还是没有出现！
这个现象引起了陈林的好奇，于是陈林决定在一次进入地狱犬领地探探究竟！陈林来到地狱犬领地，现在这里是一片荒芜，没有任何生物活动。然后陈林不断的深入来到了地狱犬的中心地段。这里是所有地狱犬幼崽聚集的地方，还有好一百多只成年地狱犬看守着！
这些地狱犬明显要比普通的强大很多，应该是头领的直系手下，但是头领却不在其中。于是陈林开始用自己的精神力不断的搜索着，看看这个神秘的头领到底去了哪里！陈林不断的用精神力搜索，可是整个地狱犬领地搜遍了也没找到！
“怎么可能没有，难道这个头领去别的地方了。应该不会现在整个族群都做战斗，而且整个族群的幼崽都在这里，它不可能走的……”陈林开始疑惑了，这个地狱犬头领到底在哪里。
于是陈林再次用精神力探索，这一次陈林更加仔细，而且只是在幼崽周围的地方搜索。陈林有预感这个头领要是存在的话，肯定不会离幼崽太远，毕竟这些幼崽都是地狱犬种族的根基！
在陈林仔细的探索下，终于被陈林发现了点疑端！在地狱犬幼崽的附近有一个小山洞，这个山洞明显有地狱犬自己开凿的痕迹，而且在山洞里陈林感觉到了一股很隐晦的能量，这股能量很强大很隐蔽。要不是陈林仔细查看，根本就察觉不到。
在确定了地方后，陈林决定要潜入山洞里一探究竟！可能是为了迷惑别人或是不想让其它的地狱犬知道，在山洞附近竟然没有地狱犬守护，于是陈林顺利的进入了山洞。在进入山洞后，陈林感觉到那股强大的神秘能量更强了，这让陈林更加确定了地狱犬头领一定在里面。
“我倒要看看到底是什么能让地狱犬头领，放着外面这么重要的事都不管，还在里面窝着不出来啊！”于是陈林就进入山洞深处。
在进入山洞深处后，陈林来到了一处仿佛是遗迹的破败的大殿中，这个大殿是传统的西式殿堂，从规模上看就知道这里以前一定是一个辉煌的宗教或是皇宫。不过现在已经破败的看不出是什么了，但是整体的框架还很坚固，而且隐约在大殿中有结界封印的感觉。
“搞的这么神秘，难道在这里有宝贝！”陈林看着周围的环境顿时被勾起了兴趣！
继续向里面走去，终于来到了一处偏殿，在这里的能量波动最强，而且那股隐晦的能量正是从此处传出去的。在陈林看向里面的时候，发现自己找对地方了，在里面正是地狱犬头领和几个手下。
让陈林感到震惊的是这个头领竟然是双头地狱犬，而且实力已经达到八阶初级。他的几个手下也都达到了七阶高级以上，它们都在围着一个黑色的能量球，不断的在吞噬着能量球散发出来的能量。
这种能量让陈林感到很熟悉，但又有点陌生陈林一时也想不起来是什么能量。不过看见这地狱犬头领和十几只手下，正在不断的吞噬着能量，而且好像都已经进入了关键时候，双头地狱犬头领两头之间隐隐有团黑色的突起，好像随时都能破开一样！而且周围的地狱犬也大都是在颈部有一个突起的大包！
这正是地狱犬要变异的先兆，头领已经要是双头地狱犬。而且马上要变异成三头地狱犬，成为地狱犬王者，其它的地狱犬也都在变异成双头地狱犬。
这个情况将陈林震住了，八阶初级的双头地狱犬还有十几只最低七阶中级的普通地狱犬，这股实力在这里根本就是横扫所有的势力啊！而且这还不算，这些地狱犬都还在不断的变异进化当中！要是他们都成功进化，那地狱犬将成为亡灵界新的一流势力！而且还是比较强的一流势力。
陈林看着这个情况，感觉这是个天大的秘密，地狱犬族群的真正实力超出了所有的周围的势力。现在陈林觉得自己让地狱犬参与战斗，好像已经脱离了自己的控制。如果地狱犬头领和这些地狱犬都出动的话，没有谁能和地狱犬为敌。

“难怪这个地狱犬头领这么稳得住，外面那么乱都不出去，原来正是变异的关键时候。看来这个黑色能量球是个了不得的宝贝啊……”陈林这样想着，觉得这个情况一定是和这个黑色能量球有关。
在发现地狱犬的情况后，觉得这个黑色能量球一定不简单，陈林忍不住的想要得到它！而且这个黑色能量球给陈琳一种很熟悉又陌生的感觉，仿佛在什么地方遇到过一样。但是陈林就是想不起来，自己到底在什么地方感受过这种能量。
于是陈林决定要用自己的精神力探测一下这个能量球，接着陈林就用自己的精神力慢慢的进入黑色能量球中，在进入后陈林就感觉自己仿佛进入冰窖一般，这个能量让陈林感觉十分的狂暴、冷血、嗜杀、毁灭！仿佛这股能量就是为了毁灭所有的以前而生的。
这股能量是那么的强大，让陈林感觉到十分的危险！突然陈林想起了这股能量为什么有熟悉的感觉“这个难到是……这个是……我一定要得到这个东西……”

Chapter 19 The mysterious treasure
The Necromancer Jessel has peak seventh-level strength, and he also has the strongest force in this area! Originally, because of the harassment from the surrounding hellhounds, Jesli was unable to unify the area, which gave Jesly a headache. But even so, Jesly won't worry about any threats, after all, his power is very strong. But just some time ago, this situation completely changed.
First, there is a mysterious force that constantly attacks his men! And they are extremely cunning. Every time I want to clean them up, they will suddenly disappear! And Harlem, which is close to me, also started to take advantage of the situation! The most irritating thing is that even the spirits and demons that I didn't take seriously before came to attack me.
Originally, the attack by these small forces would not cause much damage to Jesli! But just when Jesly was upset by these harassments, the hellhound behind Jesly also attacked him. Moreover, the entire tribe was dispatched, making Jesly feel as if he had killed their children! Let them attack you desperately! In fact, Jesly didn't know that these hellhounds thought he had killed their children. If Jesly knew about it, he would definitely vomit blood unjustly! If only the undead had blood!
Chen Lin is now like an outsider, watching the forces around him continue to fight. And he constantly uses his super mental power to explore the trends of surrounding forces, so that Xiao Hei and Ling Mo can survive this battle. The current situation is under Chen Lin's control, but the only thing that puzzles Chen Lin is that the leader of the Cerberus has not appeared so far!
This phenomenon aroused Chen Lin's curiosity, so Chen Lin decided to enter the Cerberus territory to find out! Chen Lin came to the Cerberus Territory. It was now a deserted place without any biological activity. Then Chen Lin continued to go deep into the center of Cerberus. This is where all the Cerberus puppies gather, and there are more than a hundred adult Cerberus guarding them!
These hellhounds are obviously much stronger than ordinary ones. They should be the leader's direct subordinates, but the leader is not among them. So Chen Lin began to use his mental power to continuously search to see where this mysterious leader had gone! Chen Lin kept searching with his mental power, but he couldn't find it even after searching the entire Cerberus territory!
"How could it not be possible? Could it be that this leader has gone somewhere else? The entire group is not fighting now, and the cubs of the entire group are here. It is impossible for him to leave..." Chen Lin began to wonder where the hell dog leader was.
So Chen Lin used his mental power to explore again. This time Chen Lin was more careful and only searched the area around the cub. Chen Lin had a hunch that if this leader existed, he would definitely not be too far away from the cubs. After all, these cubs are the foundation of the Cerberus race!
After Chen Lin's careful exploration, Chen Lin finally discovered something suspicious! There was a small cave near the Cerberus cubs. This cave clearly had traces of the Cerberus's own digging, and Chen Lin felt a very obscure energy in the cave. This energy was very powerful and hidden. If Chen Lin hadn't looked carefully, he wouldn't have noticed it at all.
After determining the place, Chen Lin decided to sneak into the cave to find out! Maybe it was to confuse others or not to let other hell dogs know that there were no hell dogs guarding the cave, so Chen Lin successfully entered the cave. After entering the cave, Chen Lin felt that the powerful mysterious energy was stronger, which made Chen Lin even more certain that the leader of the Cerberus must be inside.
"I want to see what could make the leader of Cerberus stay inside and unable to come out without caring about such important things outside!" So Chen Lin entered the depths of the cave.
After entering the depths of the cave, Chen Lin came to a dilapidated hall that looked like a ruins.This hall is a traditional Western-style palace. Judging from its scale, you can tell that this must have been a glorious religious or royal palace in the past. However, it is now so dilapidated that it is hard to see what it is, but the overall frame is still very strong, and there is a vague feeling of a barrier seal in the hall.
"It's so mysterious, is there a treasure here!" Chen Lin looked at the surrounding environment and his interest was suddenly aroused!
Continuing to walk inside, I finally came to a side hall, where the energy fluctuations were the strongest, and the obscure energy was transmitted from here. When Chen Lin looked inside, he found that he had found the right place. Inside was the Cerberus leader and several of his men.
What shocked Chen Lin was that this leader turned out to be a two-headed hellhound, and his strength had reached the eighth level. Several of his subordinates have also reached the seventh level or above. They are all surrounding a black energy ball, constantly devouring the energy emitted by the energy ball.
This kind of energy made Chen Lin feel very familiar, but also a little strange. Chen Lin couldn't remember what energy it was. However, I saw that the Cerberus leader and a dozen of his men were constantly devouring energy, and they seemed to have entered a critical moment. There was a faint black protrusion between the two heads of the double-headed Cerberus leader, as if it could be broken open at any time! And most of the Cerberus dogs around them have a big bump on their neck!
This is the harbinger that Cerberus will mutate, and the leader is already going to be a two-headed Cerberus. And it will soon mutate into a three-headed hellhound and become the king of hellhounds. Other hellhounds are also mutating into two-headed hellhounds.
This situation shocked Chen Lin. There were eight-level primary two-headed hellhounds and a dozen or so ordinary hellhounds that were at least seven-level intermediate levels. This strength could simply sweep all the forces here! And that's not all, these hellhounds are still mutating and evolving! If they all successfully evolve, Cerberus will become the new first-class force in the undead world! And it is still a relatively strong first-class force.
Chen Lin looked at this situation and felt that this was a huge secret. The true strength of the Cerberus group exceeded all surrounding forces. Now Chen Lin felt that he had let the Cerberus participate in the battle, as if it was out of his control. If the Cerberus leader and these Cerberus are dispatched, no one can be the enemy of the Cerberus.
"No wonder this Cerberus leader is so stable and refuses to go out when there is so much chaos outside. It turns out that this is the critical time for mutation. It seems that this black energy ball is an incredible treasure..." Chen Lin thought this way and felt that this situation must be related to this black energy ball.
After discovering the situation of Cerberus, he felt that this black energy ball must not be simple, and Chen Lin couldn't help but want to get it! Moreover, this black energy ball gave Chen Lin a very familiar yet unfamiliar feeling, as if she had encountered it somewhere before. But Chen Lin just couldn't remember where he had felt this energy.
So Chen Lin decided to use his mental power to detect this energy ball. Then Chen Lin used his mental power to slowly enter the black energy ball. After entering, Chen Lin felt as if he had entered an ice cellar. This energy made Chen Lin feel very violent, cold-blooded, murderous, and destructive! It seems that this energy was born to destroy all the past.
This energy was so powerful that Chen Lin felt very dangerous! Suddenly Chen Lin remembered why this energy had a familiar feeling. "This is so difficult... this is... I must get this thing..."
